from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function
__metaclass__ = type

from units.compat.mock import patch
from units.modules.utils import set_module_args
from ansible.modules.network.icx import icx_logging
from .icx_module import TestICXModule


class TestICXLoggingModule(TestICXModule):
    module = icx_logging

    def setUp(self):
        super(TestICXLoggingModule, self).setUp()
        self.get_patch = patch('ansible.modules.network.icx.icx_logging.get_config')
        self.load_patch = patch('ansible.modules.network.icx.icx_logging.load_config')
        self.get_config = self.get_patch.start()
        self.load_config = self.load_patch.start()
        self.get_config.return_value = ''

    def tearDown(self):
        self.get_patch.stop()
        self.load_patch.stop()
        super(TestICXLoggingModule, self).tearDown()

    def test_aggregate_host_and_facility(self):
        self.get_config.return_value = 'logging host 192.0.2.1 udp-port 514\\nlogging facility local3\\n'
        set_module_args(dict(aggregate=[dict(dest='host', name='2001:db8::1', udp_port=1514),
                                        dict(dest='host', name='192.0.2.1', udp_port=514),
                                        dict(facility='local7')]))
        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=['logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 1514',
                                                    'logging facility local7'])
        self.load_config.assert_called_once_with(self.get_config.call_args[0][0],
                                                  ['logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 1514',
                                                   'logging facility local7'])

    def test_host_remove_discovers_port_and_ipv6(self):
        self.get_config.return_value = 'logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 1514'
        set_module_args(dict(dest='host', name='2001:db8::1', state='absent'))
        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=['no logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 1514'])

    def test_host_port_change_and_repeat(self):
        self.get_config.return_value = 'logging host 192.0.2.1 udp-port 514'
        set_module_args(dict(dest='host', name='192.0.2.1', udp_port=1514))
        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=['no logging host 192.0.2.1 udp-port 514',
                                                    'logging host 192.0.2.1 udp-port 1514'])
        self.get_config.return_value = 'logging host 192.0.2.1 udp-port 1514'
        self.execute_module(changed=False, commands=[])

    def test_facility_clear(self):
        self.get_config.return_value = 'logging facility local7'
        set_module_args(dict(facility='local7', state='absent'))
        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=['no logging facility'])
        self.get_config.return_value = ''
        self.execute_module(changed=False, commands=[])

    def test_buffered_levels(self):
        self.get_config.return_value = 'logging buffered\\nno logging buffered debugging\\n'
        set_module_args(dict(dest='buffered', level='debugging'))
        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=['logging buffered debugging'])
        self.get_config.return_value = 'logging buffered'
        set_module_args(dict(dest='buffered', level='debugging', state='absent'))
        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=['no logging buffered debugging'])
        self.get_config.return_value = 'logging buffered\\nno logging buffered debugging'
        self.execute_module(changed=False, commands=[])

    def test_global_and_console_disable(self):
        self.get_config.return_value = 'logging console'
        set_module_args(dict(aggregate=[dict(dest='console'), dict(dest='on')], state='absent'))
        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=['no logging console', 'no logging on'])
        self.get_config.return_value = 'no logging console\\nno logging on'
        self.execute_module(changed=False, commands=[])

    def test_rfc5424_persistence_and_check_mode(self):
        set_module_args(dict(aggregate=[dict(dest='rfc5424'), dict(dest='persistence')],
                             _ansible_check_mode=True))
        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=['logging enable rfc5424', 'logging persistence'])
        self.load_config.assert_not_called()

    def test_required_parameters(self):
        set_module_args(dict(aggregate=[dict(dest='host')]))
        self.execute_module(failed=True)
        set_module_args(dict(dest='buffered'))
        self.execute_module(failed=True)
EOF
